title: This Fish Spits Water Six Times Stronger Than Its Own Muscles

scenes.text: This fish spits water so hard it knocks insects out of the air.
It's the archerfish. It can hit prey from about six feet away.
The jet is up to six times stronger than the fish's own muscle power.
It shapes its tongue into a tube and squeezes out the water.
The jet speeds up as it flies, so it hits harder.
A fish with a water cannon.

description:
The archerfish spits a jet of water up to six times stronger than its muscles alone could push, knocking insects off branches.
It can hit prey about six feet away.
Would you dodge it?
thumbnail_text: A FISH WITH A WATER CANNON
first_comment: The archerfish never misses much. What's your favorite animal with a weapon?
